question: True or false: in a five-year trial of 25,871 healthy US adults, vitamin D pills cut cancer and heart disease?
answer: False. In the VITAL trial, people given vitamin D had about the same rates of invasive cancer and major heart events as those on placebo. Low vitamin D goes with illness partly because sick people go out less, weigh more and eat worse. Topping up the number did not undo the reasons it was low.
move: Fixing a warning light does not fix what switched it on.
ask: Am I trying to fix a sign of a problem, when the problem itself needs the attention?
trap: True, since people low in vitamin D get these diseases more.
reference: Manson et al., Vitamin D supplements and prevention of cancer and cardiovascular disease, New England Journal of Medicine, 2019
